eComUserUpdates.name: TSQLQuery
eComUserUpdates.Description: Executes a "Select" query on a Microsoft SQL database
eComUserUpdates.Query:
SELECT 
 ecomUsers.attributes_externalId
 ,userProps.externalid1 as email
 ,pUsers.BADGE
 ,pUsers.G1 as firstname
 ,pUsers.Surname as lastname
 ,(case when userProps.STATUS  in ('DECEASED MEMBER','RETIRED MEMBERS','SUSPENSIONS','TERMINATED MEMBERS','LTD') then 'Inactive' else userProps.STATUS end) as STATUS
 ,userProps.USERNAME
 ,userProps.ROLE
 ,userProps.EVIDENCEGROUPEXTID as EVIDENCE_GROUP_EXT_ID

  FROM 
  [DataCentreOps].[dbo].[personnelUserList] as pUsers,
  [DataCentreOps].[dbo].[prevUserProps] as prevUsers,
  [DataCentreOps].[dbo].[eComUserList] as ecomUsers,
  cus_userProps as userProps
  
  where (
 userProps.Badge = prevUsers.Badge and
 userProps.Badge = eComUsers.attributes_badgeNumber and (
 (pUsers.G1 != eComUsers.attributes_firstName)
    or (pUsers.Surname != eComUsers.attributes_lastName)
 or (userProps.ROLE != prevUsers.ROLE)
 or (pUsers.Rank != prevUsers.Rank)
 or ((prevUsers.EVIDENCEGROUPEXTID != userProps.EVIDENCEGROUPEXTID) and (userProps.EVIDENCEGROUPEXTID not in ('DECEASED MEMBER','RETIRED MEMBERS','SUSPENSIONS','TERMINATED MEMBERS','LTD'))
 or (userProps.Username != ecomUsers.attributes_username)
 or ((userProps.username != ecomUsers.attributes_email) and (userProps.EVIDENCEGROUPEXTID not in ('DECEASED MEMBER','RETIRED MEMBERS','SUSPENSIONS','TERMINATED MEMBERS','LTD')))
 or (userProps.Status != ecomUsers.attributes_status)
 )
  )
 )
eComUserUpdates.description: Executes a "Select" query on a Microsoft SQL database

uploadEcomFile.name: PowerShell
uploadEcomFile.Description: Executes a Powershell script on a remote device
uploadEcomFile.ScriptCode:
$fContent = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("%currUploadFileName%")
    $encContent = [system.text.encoding]::GetEncoding('UTF-8').GetString($fContent)
    $encContent = $encContent | ForEach-Object {$_ -replace '"', ''}
    $boundary = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
    $APIURL = "https://api.ca.evidence.com"
   
    $template = @'
--{0}
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="{4}"; filename="{1}"
Content-Type: {2}

{3}
--{0}--

'@
    $cType = "multipart/form-data"
    $body = $template -f $boundary, "%currUploadFileName%", $cType, $encContent, "%currUploadType%"

    #This makes the necessary API call to import which ever type of import (User/Group/Entity Relationship)
    $import = Invoke-Restmethod -Uri "$APIURL%currUploadUri%" -Method POST -Headers $headers -ContentType "multipart/form-data; boundary=$boundary" -Body $body
